# Rakai Community School of Nursing (RCSN) - Complete Institutional Knowledge Base

## 1. Executive Summary
Rakai Community School of Nursing (RCSN) is a private not-for-profit health training institution situated in Rakai Town Council, Rakai District, Southwestern Uganda. Established in 2003 through community and Seventh-day Adventist (SDA) Church initiative, the institution addresses critical healthcare workforce shortages by preparing skilled, compassionate, and ethically grounded nurses and midwives.

- Institutional Code: ME\VOC\071 (Ministry of Education and Sports)
- Professional Accreditation: Uganda Nurses and Midwives Council (UNMC)
- National Examinations Center: Uganda Health Professions Assessment Board (UHPAB) Center Code **U151**
- Total Alumni: Over 10,000 healthcare practitioners deployed across Ugandan public health facilities, NGOs, mission hospitals, and private clinical networks.
- Website: https://www.rcsn.ac.ug
- General Email: info@rcsn.ac.ug
- Admissions Email: admissions@rcsn.ac.ug
- Official Inquiries: +256 772 846 174 | +256 701 568 290 | +256 782 867 071

## 2. Academic Curricula & Entry Requirements

### Certificate in Nursing (2.5 Years)
- Award: Certificate in Nursing (conferred by UHPAB)
- Eligibility: UCE minimum pass in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics and English (or equivalent), obtained in the same sitting.

### Certificate in Midwifery (2.5 Years)
- Award: Certificate in Midwifery (conferred by UHPAB)
- Eligibility: UCE minimum pass in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics and English (or equivalent), obtained in the same sitting.

### Diploma in Nursing • Direct (3 Years)
- Award: Diploma in Nursing (UHPAB)
- Eligibility: UCE, UACE level; Principal Pass in Biology and a subsidiary in Chemistry.

### Diploma in Midwifery • Direct (3 Years)
- Award: Diploma in Midwifery (UHPAB)
- Eligibility: UCE, UACE level; Principal Pass in Biology and a subsidiary in Chemistry.

### Diploma in Nursing • Extension (1.5 Years)
- Award: Diploma in Nursing (UHPAB)
- Eligibility: Possess Certificate in Nursing, Comprehensive Nursing, Psychiatry.

### Diploma in Midwifery • Extension (1.5 Years)
- Award: Diploma in Midwifery (UHPAB)
- Eligibility: Possess Certificate in Midwifery.

## 3. Clinical Practicum & Affiliated Partner Hospitals
The school partners with 7 accredited healthcare facilities for hands-on clinical rotations:
1. **Rakai General Hospital** (Primary Clinical Teaching Center) - Located in Rakai Town, adjacent to the campus. Students complete weekly rotations across outpatient, inpatient, pediatric, surgical, and maternity wards.
2. **Masaka Regional Referral Hospital** - Major referral center in Masaka City for intensive care, specialized surgical units, and high-volume casualty wards.
3. **Mubende Regional Referral Hospital** - Referral hospital partner for diverse patient case studies and infectious disease management.
4. **Lyantonde General Hospital** - General clinical training partner on the Masaka–Mbarara corridor.
5. **Kitovu Hospital (St. Joseph's Masaka)** - Acclaimed missionary hospital specializing in maternal-child health and surgical mentorship.
6. **Kalisizo General Hospital** - District hospital in Kyotera District for maternity and clinical postings.
7. **Kakuto Health Centre IV** - Primary health care (PHC) and community medicine field post.

## 4. Campus Infrastructure & Facilities
- **Clinical Skills Laboratory**: Simulation room equipped with full-body patient mannequins, obstetric delivery models, hospital beds, oxygen delivery equipment, IV administration arms, and wound-dressing sets.
- **Learning Resource Center & Library**: Stocked with current editions of nursing and midwifery textbooks, anatomy atlases, pharmacology compendiums, e-learning workstations, and quiet revision cubicles.
- **Student Hostels**: Separate on-campus accommodation facilities for female and male students, monitored by resident wardens and matrons with 24/7 security.
- **Dining & Assembly Hall**: Campus hall serving balanced meals daily, morning cohort devotions, and tutor clinical briefings.
- **Recreational Grounds**: Sports pitch and open grounds hosting student volleyball, netball, and athletics.
- **Chaplaincy & Counseling**: Dedicated chaplaincy offering spiritual care, moral guidance, and mentorship.
